collection.title: Volkswagen Transporter T6.1 2019 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Transporter T6.1 2019 - 2024 model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Transporter T6, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
